name: Gerah
overview: The term 'Gerah' in Scripture refers to a specific unit of weight and currency, defined as one-twentieth of a shekel, equating to approximately thirteen and seven-tenths grains according to the Paris standard. It also functioned as a coin, roughly equivalent to three American cents or three half-pence in English money. The passages in Exodus 30:13, Leviticus 27:25, and Numbers 3:47 consistently present the gerah as a fundamental measure within the sanctuary's system of weights and offerings, underscoring its role in the precise valuation of contributions and obligations before the Lord.
